policy: No external image, model, audio or font files are shipped. All game art is generated at runtime by code in this repository. The one external input is map data: Quayside's streets, buildings, river and landmarks are derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), listed below.

assets.kind: textures (asphalt, pavement, promenade, sand, grass, wood, roof, concrete, facade atlases, awning stripes, palm frond, glow, clouds, car decals)
assets.origin: procedurally painted on HTML canvas at load time
assets.author: this project

assets.origin: canvas text rendering of invented names with system fonts
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: buildings, roads, markings, props, pier, Ferris wheel, radio mast, lighthouse
assets.origin: generated from the hand-designed layout in code
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: 5 vehicle models (sports, sedan, taxi, police, van)
assets.origin: extruded side profiles defined as coordinate lists
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: articulated low-poly humans with procedural animation
assets.author: this project

assets.origin: string sprites and procedural noise in code
assets.author: this project

assets.origin: original HTML/CSS/canvas; not derived from any commercial spreadsheet's assets
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: street network, building footprints and heights, shoreline, parks, jetties, the Elizabeth Quay Bridge path, the South Perth ferry route
assets.origin: OpenStreetMap, Overpass API export of Elizabeth Quay and Perth Water (Western Australia)
assets.source: examples/quayside/data/osm-eq.txt, processed by scripts/quayside/build_city.py into data/city.json and data/ground.png
assets.author: © OpenStreetMap contributors

assets.kind: procedural facades (glass towers, offices, heritage brick and sandstone, shopfronts), ground materials, river shader, sky, night lighting
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: Elizabeth Quay Bridge arches, Spanda sculpture, Bell Tower spire, jetties, trees, river ferry (generic livery), river police boat
assets.origin: modelled in code from public photographs and the OSM geometry; no operator logos or liveries
assets.author: this project

assets.kind: lofted car bodies with glasshouse, five-spoke wheels (Quayside style)
assets.origin: cross-sections generated from the side profiles
assets.author: this project
